site.title: The Best Is Yet to Come
site.intro: 57 years behind you. So many beautiful miles still ahead.
site.finalLetter:
Happy 57th birthday, Nannagaru.

Look how far you’ve travelled, and look at all the life that still lies ahead.

You’ve spent so many years working hard, taking care of your responsibilities, and building a life for the people you love.

But your life is about more than the work you’ve done and the responsibilities you’ve carried. You deserve to enjoy the life you’ve worked so hard to build.

There are still places to see, experiences to discover, hobbies to explore, festivals to celebrate, and countless memories for us to make together.

You don't have to live every year at the same pace. It's okay to slow down and discover what makes you happy.

As you approach Shashtipoorthi, I hope you see it as another beautiful milestone, not a finish line.

We still have so much road ahead of us, Nanna. And I hope we get to travel a great deal of it together.

Happy birthday. I love you. ❤️
